fuel_type.note: wood, charcoal, propane, electric, none (unpowered furniture)

fuel_consumption_per_min.note: Per IN-GAME minute of use (40 real minutes = 1 full in-game day = 1440 in-game minutes at 1x speed - keeps consumption correct if the player speeds up time). For fuel_type wood/charcoal: fractional fuel ITEMS per in-game minute (matches fuel category's burn_minutes_per_item). For propane: liters per in-game minute. For electric/none: 0.

power_draw_w.note: watts drawn while running, for fuel_type electric only. 0 for wood/charcoal/propane appliances (they don't pull from the electric grid) and unpowered furniture.

bandwidth_usage_mbps.note: Mbps consumed while actively streaming, TVs only (this is the internet category's bandwidth-consumer counterpart to a producer's bandwidth_mbps - see internet.schema.json's TODO note on the overload check: sum of active consumers' bandwidth_usage_mbps vs. the connected producer's bandwidth_mbps). 0 for every other appliance.

water_usage_lpm.note: liters per in-game minute drawn while actively running - this is the water category's consumer counterpart to a pump's max_flow_rate_lpm (see water.schema.json). Sinks, dishwashers, washers only. 0 for every other appliance, including the water heaters - they heat water passing through, they don't net-consume it themselves.

cold_resistance_pct.note: percent offset against the wellness penalty for cold/winter exposure (see _base.schema.json's wellness_modifier note on the weather mechanic) while worn/equipped. Winter coat and any future cold-weather gear only. 0 for everything else - this is protection while worn, not a one-time restore, which is why it's separate from properties.wellness_modifier.

water_per_use_l.note: liters one use takes (a sink 4, a toilet flush 6, a shower 60, a washer load 50-120, a dishwasher load 12-20). A right click on the placed fixture in a building that has water and a waste outlet piped to a septic system uses it: the water comes from the building's supply and goes down the drain to the septic tank (docs/SEPTIC.md). 0 for everything that uses no water.
